decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal, due to the design and materials of the windows and the excessive height and bulk of the structures over the cycle and car parking areas would be detrimental to the setting of this attractive building, the street scene and the Conservation Area. This would be contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and ENV-1.2 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and Policies ENV-B.1.1 and ENV-B.2.2 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001).

Condition : 2 - No details have been provided of the cycle racks to be used and the cycle parking would not provide adequate protection or security for cycles. The structure over the parking spaces would inhibit access to the parking spaces which could reduce the use of these spaces leading to additional on-street parking. This would be contrary to Policies T.2.5 and T.3.6 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and Policies T.1.4 and T.4.4 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001).
description: Following approval for erection of a four storey side extension and conversion of existing dwellinghouse to four one bedroom flats and four two bedroom flats incorporating replacement windows - details received pursuant to condition 2 (roof / windows over parking / cycle area) of permission dated 25/7/02
